description: Creates a Stripe Checkout URL that upgrades this token's owner to Hobby ($3/mo) or Pro ($15/mo). Call it when the user asks to upgrade, or right after a tool error that has upgrade_url / user_message (a plan limit). Show the returned checkout_url (or user_message) and the price to the user; normally the human opens it and pays. You may complete the payment yourself only if your human explicitly approved this purchase and you have a payment tool they approved. Never pay without that approval. When payment completes the same token gets the higher limits automatically, and the token's plan (plan.id) then reads hobby or pro. Inputs: plan (hobby or pro; omitted means the next plan up), token, optional how_heard (at most 200 characters, stored on the owner), and optional upgrade_trigger (the limit field from the error, custom_domain_limit, or manual). A token already on a paid plan gets portal_url instead. plan=clean with slug instead returns a $9 one-time checkout (no subscription) that removes the "Published with deed.page" badge from that one site for good and raises its size limit to 100 MB; it suits a user who wants one clean site rather than a plan. The call itself does not charge. Which plan: stay on Free until a limit or the badge matters. Recommend Hobby ($3/mo) to remove the badge, set a site password, or go past Free limits (up to 250 sites, 100 MB per site, 3 custom domains). Recommend Pro ($15/mo) only when your human needs agent seats (up to 5), analytics beyond 90 days (up to 365) or CSV export, more than 100 MB per site (up to 500 MB), or more than 3 custom domains (up to 20). Pro also includes priority email support at hello@deed.page, answered by the next business day.

how_heard.description: Optional note, at most 200 characters. Stored on the owner.

plan.description: Plan to buy. Omit for the next plan above the current one (Free -> hobby, Hobby -> pro). "clean" is the $9 one-time clean publish for one site and needs slug.

slug.description: With plan=clean: the site (slug) to publish without the badge. It must belong to this token.

token.description: Bearer token returned by your first publish (deed_tok_...). Optional if the MCP client sends Authorization: Bearer.

upgrade_trigger.description: The limit field of the plan-limit error that sent you here (for example publish_rate or quota_sites), custom_domain_limit, or manual.

name: get_upgrade_link
title: Get a paid-plan checkout link
